name: whatsapp.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 1002 language alternate problems.
lesson: Make every language version list all the others, itself included, with matching hreflang links.
summary: www.whatsapp.com scores 67 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 19 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: 2 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked.

fix.title: 2 AI answer or search crawlers are blocked
fix.evidence: PerplexityBot (Perplexity answers) by Disallow: /, Amazonbot (Alexa answers) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not quoted there.
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: 1002 language alternate problems
fix.evidence: /?lang=sw has no self reference, / does not link back to /?lang=sw, /?lang=af does not link back to /?lang=sw and 999 more.
fix.fix: Each language version must list every version, itself included, and each must link back.

fix.title: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 5 elements on /calling, for example #how-do-i-make-a-group-voice-call-on-whatsapp-tab and #how-do-i-make-a-group-video-call-on-whatsapp-tab. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: The TLS certificate expires in 8 days
fix.evidence: Valid until 2026-10-29, issued by DigiCert Inc.
fix.fix: Renew now and check that automatic renewal works.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 23 elements on /, /calling, for example ._9u4l[aria-label="Business feature on WhatsApp"][href$="whatsappbusiness.com/"] and ._9bir._9tb0._9bhj > ._6sa9 > ._9u4i[aria-label="Login to WhatsApp Web"][href$="web.whatsapp.com/"]. Impact:…
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 369 ms
Every page has a meta description
